pairedFixture.method: Interleaved frozen real-renderer draw calls, same input, separate source canvases: 80 measured samples per source after eight warmups; source order alternates each iteration and yields every eight pairs. CPU only, not GPU/FPS. All scenes contain six fields, eight divine effects and two active skills. Lower density uses 70 projectiles/90 static drops; dense 480/180; loot-only 0/180. Separate contexts prevent one source from inheriting the other canvas command state.

fusionFixture.method: Constructed stationary rendering fixture at 1100x650, area x2.4, real weapon fire/draw paths. Not a gameplay completion or a natural build. High/low quality; 80 warmed draw samples. CPU time only, no GPU/FPS claim. Same fixed post-construction geometry in paired versions.
